description: Code 2B#### with index 70 and ondex 9. The table row defines a two-character ondex field for this current-only code and states no constraint on its value, so the decoded structure reports the ondex as encoded.

dispute.raised_at: generators/DISAGREEMENTS.md in this repository, 2026-10-01; not yet raised with the CESR specification working group.
dispute.summary: The Annex indexed code table gives 2B#### (Ed25519 indexed sig big current only) an ondex field of two characters and states no constraint on its value, so a stream carrying ondex 9 decodes to index 70, ondex 9. keripy main (9a8b7aa7) rejects it: Indexer raises 'Invalid ondex=9 for code=2B' because keripy requires the ondex of every current-only code to be zero (src/keri/core/indexing.py, the IdxCrtSigDex checks in _exfil and _bexfil). The specification should either state that constraint, making this a must-reject stream, or confirm that the field is free.

title: Parse a big current-only Ed25519 signature whose ondex field is not zero
